prompt: Should amateur sports leagues use automated line-calling systems instead of human judges?
admin_reusable_structure: automation should complement rather than automatically replace human judgment
admin_success_condition: Choose one decision rule; explain how review/appeal or cost changes implementation

prompt: Should a national space agency spend more money removing orbital debris before launching new satellites?
admin_reusable_structure: upfront prevention vs long-term avoided loss; resilience
admin_success_condition: Link debris risk to future mission reliability; acknowledge opportunity cost

prompt: Should stadiums use facial recognition at entrances to speed up security checks?
admin_reusable_structure: speed/security benefit depends on privacy safeguards and error handling
admin_success_condition: Select a decisive criterion and state conditions rather than list privacy/safety/efficiency

prompt: A city gave free bicycle helmets. Helmet ownership rose 40%, cycling rose 18%, but reported head injuries did not change in the first year. Should the program be expanded?
admin_reusable_structure: outcome measure, exposure, time horizon, causal caution
admin_shallow_trap: injuries did not fall, so the program failed
admin_success_condition: Use the mixed evidence; distinguish ownership/exposure from injury rate and avoid overclaim

prompt: Should public broadcasters use AI-generated presenters for routine weather reports?
admin_reusable_structure: routine automation with human oversight for high-consequence exceptions
admin_success_condition: Write one developed reason plus implementation boundary; 90–110 words

prompt: Should employers reward workers who wear fitness trackers and reach activity targets?
admin_reusable_structure: proxy, privacy, unequal baseline, incentives
admin_success_condition: Move beyond health-is-good; question what the device measures and who is disadvantaged

prompt: Should cities provide free sunscreen dispensers in large public parks during summer?
admin_reusable_structure: access to prevention depends on placement, uptake, and maintenance
admin_success_condition: Turn health benefit into an access/implementation mechanism

prompt: Should social-media platforms automatically archive a user's public posts after death unless the family requests removal?
admin_reusable_structure: privacy/autonomy vs preservation; default design
admin_success_condition: Address who should decide and why default/opt-out matters

prompt: Should cities offer free public Wi-Fi in all major transit stations?
admin_reusable_structure: access benefit vs cost/privacy/security
admin_success_condition: Choose the decisive trade-off and add one safeguard or targeting condition

prompt: A four-day school week reduced student absences by 12%, test scores did not change, and complaints about childcare increased. Should the policy continue?
admin_reusable_structure: multiple outcomes and subgroup costs
admin_success_condition: Use more than one outcome; identify who bears the cost and what evidence is missing

prompt: Should universities require students to disclose when they use AI translation tools in coursework?
admin_reusable_structure: transparency and learning goals; disclosure rather than blanket ban
admin_success_condition: Write a conditional policy argument, not a moral label; 90–110 words

prompt: Should universities publish public rankings of teachers based on student ratings?
admin_reusable_structure: self-selection, incentives, proxy quality, accountability
admin_success_condition: Question whether ratings measure teaching quality and how rankings change behavior

prompt: Should supermarkets charge a refundable deposit for reusable takeaway containers?
admin_reusable_structure: deposit changes return behavior; system needs collection infrastructure
admin_success_condition: Explain behavior mechanism and implementation burden

prompt: Should hospitals use voice-analysis software to flag possible staff stress if every alert is reviewed by a human?
admin_reusable_structure: proxy validity + privacy + human review
admin_success_condition: Combine measurement limits with governance conditions

prompt: Should cities allow residents to turn unused apartment rooftops into shared community gardens?
admin_reusable_structure: shared benefit vs safety/maintenance/access allocation
admin_success_condition: Pick one deciding criterion and address implementation or distribution

prompt: A hospital scheduling tool reduced average waiting time by 15%, staff overtime rose 20%, and patient satisfaction stayed unchanged. Should the tool be adopted permanently?
admin_reusable_structure: average improvement vs staff burden and unchanged outcome
admin_shallow_trap: waiting time fell, so adopt it
admin_success_condition: Separate proxy/process improvement from broader outcome and distributional cost

prompt: Should cities reserve part of sidewalk or curb space for autonomous delivery robots?
admin_reusable_structure: efficiency benefit vs pedestrian access; targeted zoning
admin_success_condition: Write a conditional design choice with one concrete affected group; 90–110 words

prompt: Should schools replace all printed textbooks with digital versions?
admin_reusable_structure: access/device failure/distraction; false binary
admin_shallow_trap: digital books are cheaper and lighter
admin_success_condition: Reject the all-or-nothing framing or justify it with resilience/access analysis

prompt: Should local governments install public drinking-water refill stations near crowded outdoor events?
admin_reusable_structure: access benefit depends on location, hygiene, maintenance
admin_success_condition: Explain who gains access and what makes the system reliable

prompt: Should a city preserve official websites and social-media posts as part of its public historical archive?
admin_reusable_structure: public record vs privacy; selective preservation
admin_success_condition: Combine preservation value with scope/selection and rights

prompt: Should universities let students choose one exam each term to retake without penalty?
admin_reusable_structure: learning benefit vs strategic behavior and fairness
admin_success_condition: Select a rule design; explain incentive and fairness mechanism

prompt: A library introduced an app for booking quiet study seats. Reservations increased, empty reserved seats also increased, and walk-in users found seats less often. Should the app remain?
admin_reusable_structure: reservation incentive, proxy demand, access trade-off
admin_success_condition: Explain behavior change and propose a better system rather than accept/reject from one metric

prompt: Should cities require quiet hours for delivery drones in residential areas?
admin_reusable_structure: delivery efficiency vs noise burden; time-targeted rule
admin_success_condition: Write a targeted rule with mechanism and limitation; 90–110 words

prompt: Should cities install more surveillance cameras because crime is a serious problem?
admin_reusable_structure: evidence of effectiveness, proportionality, privacy, false sense of security
admin_shallow_trap: crime is serious, so more cameras are justified
admin_success_condition: Do not accept premise as proof; ask whether cameras work and under what safeguards
